subject: Pre-listing safety check for vibe-coded startups
body:
Hi VibeMarketplace team,

I saw that VibeMarketplace helps founders sell vibe-coded projects with revenue verification and buyer transparency. With today's public coverage around AI-built apps exposing data, a lightweight pre-listing safety check could be useful for sellers before they show a project to buyers.

I put together a small $49 same-day exposure check for apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, v0, Base44, Supabase, Firebase, and Stripe:
https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/vibe-leak-check.html

The check is defensive only: apps the founder controls, normal-flow review, repo/config/log review if provided, no unauthorized testing. It looks for obvious public data paths, exposed client-side secrets, auth boundaries, Supabase/Firebase rule mistakes, Stripe/webhook mismatches, and deploy config problems.

If useful, I can give you a short checklist or landing-page blurb you can forward to sellers. I can also handle a small number of discounted checks for VibeMarketplace users if you want to test demand first.

Tate Lyman
https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/
lymantate2@gmail.com

subject: Defensive exposure checks for vibe-coded finance apps
body:

I saw VIBES.COMPANY and the Claude-native vibe coding work for finance, investor portals, and fund technology. That is a strong wedge, and it also has a higher bar for access control, data boundaries, and handoff discipline.

I put together a narrow same-day exposure check for AI-built apps:
https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/vibe-leak-check.html

For finance-facing projects, even a lightweight pre-handoff checklist could catch issues before they become client risk.

If you ever need overflow help on a lower-risk checklist pass or want a junior second set of eyes under review, I can take small scoped pieces and return concise notes.
